newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Lightly quoted on call.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Lightly quoted on call.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were lightly quoted Monday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session, the exchange said. No barges traded versus none on Friday.
- One barge, upper Mississippi above mile 266 through Dubuque, on tow, offered at 175 percent of tariff, no bid.
- Two barges, lower Ohio, above mile 400 Memphis through Cairo, on tow, offered at 125 percent, no bid.
- One barge (High cube lift top rake), Mississippi (Granite City), grain or produce, constructive placement March 14 or 15, bid at 130 percent, no offer.
